Codex review: blocked before merge. ## What this changes This PR upgrades bundled Codex from 0.164.0 to 0.169.0, refreshes protocol validators, and recognizes its native launch diagnostics. **Example:** A completed failed turn contains audio input {"type":"audio","fileId":"file-audio-1"}. - **Before:** The old schema requires an audio URL and rejects the terminal snapshot. - **After:** The regenerated validator accepts the uploaded-file reference and preserves the terminal snapshot. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🧂 unranked krab **(1/6)** | The patch is focused and source-consistent, but its supplied evidence does not meet the required product-behavior proof standard. | | **Proof confidence** | 🧂 unranked krab **(1/6)** | Real behavior proof is not required for maintainer- or bot-authored pull requests. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Bug fix · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** The bundled native runtime can lag models available to an account and reject newer terminal snapshot shapes. **Reason:** The maintainer-authored direction addresses a concrete compatibility problem and remains distinct from the merged picker and relay repairs. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Blocked before merge - 1 item remains** Keep this PR open: the bundled-runtime upgrade remains useful, the earlier relay blocker is resolved, and no introduced code defect was found. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `d2496ff4de05b0365d010783eea25b06affaaf3e` ## Before merge - [ ] **Await maintainer action** - A repository admin or active SecOps member must approve this revision’s dependency changes, and a maintainer must approve the current revision for the enforced CI gate. ## Findings None. ### Tests - Missing end-to-end proof: Provide redacted installed-Gateway evidence of native discovery and turn completion with Codex 0.169.0, including a latest-stable upgrade retaining settings and conversation history; the audio fileId regression also lacks an explicitly reported base-fail/head-pass result.
Agent review details ### How this fits together The Codex plugin launches the managed native app-server, relays provider requests, and validates native responses before projecting them into OpenClaw conversation state. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[OpenClaw session] --> B[Codex plugin] B --> C[Managed Codex app-server] C --> D[Inference relay] D --> E[Provider catalog and inference] C --> F[Protocol validators] F --> G[Conversation projection] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Keep the synchronized runtime and protocol refresh in the existing Codex owners while preserving the landed picker, relay, and authentication contracts. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Source confirms that native discovery sends the runtime version and the old validator rejects audio fileId snapshots; account-specific backend availability was not independently reproduced. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The synchronized dependency and generated-schema refresh addresses the compatibility boundary without introducing another discovery owner or changing authentication policy. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [ec9a77fa3c04](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ec9a77fa3c04031211749b61a5814fa563e315af). ### Provenance checked - `Managed runtime, discovery fallback, and ACP version parity` keeps the original intent (70f8ce638c3961f196ed8e4dc8d1f1202f39c0f0: The previous runtime refresh aligned the managed package, native platforms, discovery hint, and ACP selection.) - `Generated protocol validation` keeps the original intent (f52fb07f74b17abed92bf644e1aabcfc204a2e46: Generate fixed-schema validators during development while retaining one runtime validation owner and matching diagnostics.) - `Permanent native launch failure recognition` keeps the original intent (6ae2babeb4c3a4c3d52dfaf394f84984f32da5d7: Retain permanent executable launch failures and stop repeated catalog launch attempts.) - `Catalog relay coverage` keeps the original intent (ed3230dd29d1e162d814e38eff00f64dc77af64e: Forward bounded catalog GET requests through the existing destination and credential boundaries.) ### Testing Proof path: in-process harness. ### Security None. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Pinned change and current-main behavior:** The introduced diff synchronizes the managed dependency, ACP override, runtime constant, discovery fallback, and generated protocol; fetched main still ships Codex 0.164.0. ([`extensions/codex/src/app-server/version.ts:2`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/d2496ff4de05b0365d010783eea25b06affaaf3e/extensions/codex/src/app-server/version.ts#L2), [d2496ff4de05](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d2496ff4de05b0365d010783eea25b06affaaf3e)) - **Authoritative dependency contract:** The patch executes @openai/codex and derives validators from its protocol, making this dependency authoritative; personally inspected rust-v0.169.0 source confirms audio fileId support, versioned catalog requests, and the execve launcher. ([`codex-rs/app-server-protocol/src/protocol/v2/turn.rs:466`](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/d32063f96c2dff1dc96af839b3952abb6acfeda4/codex-rs/app-server-protocol/src/protocol/v2/turn.rs#L466), [d32063f96c2d](https://github.com/openai/codex/commit/d32063f96c2dff1dc96af839b3952abb6acfeda4)) - **Earlier relay blocker resolved:** Ben Badejo’s https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/197768 merged the catalog relay repair; this PR retains additional native-discovery and cleanup tests without duplicating its production implementation. ([`extensions/codex/src/app-server/inference-proxy.native.test.ts:241`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/ed3230dd29d1e162d814e38eff00f64dc77af64e/extensions/codex/src/app-server/inference-proxy.native.test.ts#L241), [ed3230dd29d1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ed3230dd29d1e162d814e38eff00f64dc77af64e)) - **Complementary picker repair:** https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/200811 independently broadens subscription-picker discovery to client_version=99.0.0 and records a same-account live catalog comparison; native discovery still uses the binary version. ([`extensions/openai/base-url.ts:16`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/0a27bd7f85fa6af2964182a8c54a709b143fdefe/extensions/openai/base-url.ts#L16), [0a27bd7f85fa](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0a27bd7f85fa6af2964182a8c54a709b143fdefe)) - **Supplied validation boundary:** The body explicitly identifies the external native-catalog fetch as mocked, reports focused passing tests and codex-cli 0.169.0, and does not claim a live GPT-6.2 turn. ([`extensions/codex/src/app-server/inference-proxy.native.test.ts:258`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/d2496ff4de05b0365d010783eea25b06affaaf3e/extensions/codex/src/app-server/inference-proxy.native.test.ts#L258), [d2496ff4de05](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d2496ff4de05b0365d010783eea25b06affaaf3e)) - **Current-head approval gates:** The current revision remains mergeable but blocked: ci-gate requires maintainer approval and dependency-review requires admin or SecOps approval; these are approval gates rather than attributed code failures. ([d2496ff4de05](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d2496ff4de05b0365d010783eea25b06affaaf3e)) Likely related people: - **Peter Steinberger:** Raw commit 6ae2babeb4c3a4c3d52dfaf394f84984f32da5d7 adds extensions/codex/src/app-server/managed-launcher-failure.ts:7 relative to its recorded parents. This identifies author metadata, not feature responsibility or a PR merger.
